Welcome to Snapgrove v1.8.0! 🥳

We’ve rolled up our sleeves and given the engine some serious love under the hood. No more sweating over corrupted moves, rogue selections, or sluggish bin lookups. Everything is smoother, faster, and much safer.

### What's New & Polished
- **Bulletproof Selection Engine**: Switched item tracking to true file identity. Flinging through thousands of screenshots or switching sort orders won't accidentally select or delete the wrong image anymore. 🤩
- **Transactional Move & Safe Undo**: Moving files now gives you clear partial-failure feedback, and hitting Undo precisely restores renamed collision files without hijacking your older photos.
- **Instant Windows Bin**: Deleted files on Windows now recycle natively via Win32 Shell API in under 2 milliseconds. No more sluggish shell process pauses. 😎
- **Automated Windows Desktop Releases**: Windows packages (`.zip`) are now built, Authenticode-signed, and published right alongside Android in our automated CI/CD pipeline!
- **Zero-Byte Deletion Hazard Vanquished**: Android SAF moves and encrypted Bin ops strictly verify byte integrity before touching the source. Your photos stay safe. 🫡
- **Toolchain Modernization**: Upgraded Gradle wrapper to 9.3.1 with Flutter dependency validation bypassing for clean, reproducible builds.

Happy organizing! 🙂
